name: باي موب — سحب آخر 14 يوم (سدّ الفجوات)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.wallet (
  id, terminal_id, machine_name, branch, order_id, type,
  ammount, fees, vat, netammount, balance,
  "from", "to", closed, done, is_excess, "createdAt", "updatedAt"
)
VALUES (
  NULLIF($1,'null')::bigint,
  $2, $3, $4, $5, COALESCE(NULLIF($6,'null'),'SALE'),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'null')::numeric,0),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($8,'null')::numeric,0),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($9,'null')::numeric,0),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($10,'null')::numeric,0),
  NULLIF($11,'null')::numeric,
  NULLIF($12,'null'),
  NULLIF($13,'null'),
  NULLIF($14,'null')::boolean,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($15,'null')::boolean,false),
  NULLIF($16,'null')::boolean,
  NULLIF($17,'null')::timestamptz,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($18,'null')::timestamptz, now())
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  ammount     = EXCLUDED.ammount,
  fees        = EXCLUDED.fees,
  vat         = EXCLUDED.vat,
  netammount  = EXCLUDED.netammount,
  type        = EXCLUDED.type,
  closed      = EXCLUDED.closed,
  is_excess   = EXCLUDED.is_excess,
  "updatedAt" = EXCLUDED."updatedAt";
